title: Retina and RPE/Choroid RNA Extraction Protocol
author: Chottiwatt Jittprasong
materials: Air dry the RNA pellet for 00:05:00

steps.title: Homogenize Retina Samples
steps.instruction: Homogenize the retina in a fume hood using TRIzol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1000 µL of TRIzol per retina.
Pipette up and down 30 times to homogenize the mixture.

steps.title: First Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add Chloroform
steps.instruction: Add chloroform to the lysis mixture and mix thoroughly.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of Chloroform per 1000 µL of TRIzol used.

steps.title: Second Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on ice for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample to separate the phases.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12000 x g for 15 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Recover Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase containing the RNA to a new tube, ensuring the interphase layer is not penetrated.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Add isopropanol and Glycoblue to the aqueous phase to precipitate RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of Isopropanol per 1000 µL of TRIzol used.
Add 4 µL of Glycoblue and mix well.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at -4 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Pellet RNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge to collect the RNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 30000 x g for 15 minutes at 4 °C.
Verify that a blue pellet is present at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 75% ethanol. This process must be performed twice.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1000 µL of 75% ethanol (on ice) per 1000 µL of TRIzol used.
Centrifuge at 7500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Repeat this wash step a second time.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in RNase free water.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 20-50 µL of RNase free water (40 µL is recommended).
